segments.text:
V. 35.
The Holy Ghoſt ſhall come upon thee, and the power of the Higheſt ſhall overſhadow thee—The Power of GOD was put forth by the Holy Ghoſt, as the immediate Divine Agent in this Work: And ſo He exerted the Power of the Higheſt as his own Power, who together with the Father and the Son is the Moſt High GOD. Therefore alſo—Not only as He is GOD from Eternity, but on this Account likewiſe He ſhall be called the Son of God.
